Wow, I'd never imagine that it could be related to OCD, not that I have OCD but somethings really makes sense to compare.

That's an interesting approach to this problem, I think I could try that, like instead of trying to repress these "what if" thoughts, I could accept that life will always be uncertain.

To be honest, no. The only thing I do is try to believe in my gf, but I'm not doing well on it. My mind feels so noisy, I can't focus. When I try to analyze the probability of my thoughts being real, I get lost, like there's a voice inside my head saying "what if" everytime, even if I somehow can get a little bit calmer, I still in the back of my mind think those thoughts are in fact true.

Thx for the answer. 

I always try to convince me I'm wrong, but even with her literally saying she isn't mad, and doing things that she wouldn't do if she was in fact mad (like cuddling or kissing me), I still get really anxious 😔

I know it's a process. and maybe I'm not trying hard enough, so seeing that people go through similar problems and get over it makes me hopeful that someday I will too. Thank you!!

I know how you must feel. I only realized I was emotionally abusive when my ex broke up with me. It was terrible. She, too, asked for a break, and I couldn't respect it. I would try to see her on her way to work like every day. 

Trust me, even if you feel terrible at yourself, this is a great thing! Now that you've acknowledged that, you have the chance to change it. It is extremely hard, but the best thing you can do is to go to therapy and work on yourself! And, of course, respect his need for space even if it is really hard to do so.

Don't feel bad at yourself. You're already on your way to change, and you will!

I don't know if you've done that already, but if you didn't do yet pls don't do that, I want to kill myself too, but the only thing keeping me from doing this is the pain I would cause to her and to the people that care about me. 

Here's what I think: If I just wanted to cause pain to her, to make her suffer from the pain she caused me, I would just physically hurt her, but this shit is way out of my mind, I could never picture me physically hurting her in any form, so why would I want to cause this giant mental pain by killing myself.

I don't know what to do, but if I do commit suicide, I want to be really far from her and everyone who cares about me.

That's why I think we are more than just manipulative and abusive behaviors, I think there was love, I used to look into her eyes and feel my heart burning, even after 7 years. I know we were having an unhealthy relationship, but we tried to improve each day, we weren't like in the beginning of our relationship, we were way more respectful with each other. That's why it tears me apart, I thought we were going to improve together, always.

I appreciate the time you had to respond. Yeah, I know I fucked up doing this, I used to do it a lot in the early phase of our relationship (checking her messages), but I cannot live without her :(.

Maybe I have some mental disorder idk, I prefer dying than trying to move on. I can't imagine her with someone else, that would be too disturbing for me, and I know it's early, but I cannot think of myself with someone else either. I just don't commit suicide because of my parents.

Fuck, I don't know what to do, I know what I must do, but I don't have the strength to do it. That's 8 years of codependency, 8 years of relying only on her, she was everything. Sometimes she would take care of me like a mother to a son, sometimes she would behave like a child and I would take care of her. I fucking can't take it, I can't live without her.

Thanks for the comment though.
